results.title: The Conviction
results.overview: Dexter, an ex-convict attempts to reconnect with his ex-wife Audrey a day after his release. Dexter comes to a shocking discovery.

results.title: The Beetle Project
results.overview: In North Korea, torrential rains force the dams open, sending floodwater into the south. Later, two kids in South Korea pick up a plastic bag carrying a beetle in the stream. When they learn that the beetle is a North Korean child’s school project, they raise the beetle for him.

results.title: For Venida, for Kalief
results.overview: Kalief Browder’s story unfolds in full when his life, and that of his mother, Venida Brodnax Browder, are tragically derailed by years of malintent from the justice system. Venida’s poems serve as a guiding thread through this emotional journey, blending archival footage and contemporary political movements to honor the Browder family’s powerful legacy, both within their community and beyond.

results.title: If You See a Cat
results.overview: After losing his cat Nyago, young Naoki’s consciousness isn’t ready to let go of his beloved companion just yet. Diagnosed, institutionalised and heavily medicated, he enters a system that dulls his mind and threatens their precious bond.

results.title: Edipo a Colono 2025
results.overview: Blind and wandering, Oedipus arrives in Colonus, near Athens, supported by Antigone and then also by Ismene. Everyone avoided him, but now everyone seeks him, because the city that will have his tomb will be invincible, according to the oracles. Oedipus drives everyone away and, accompanied by the Athenian king Theseus, sets off towards death. Directed by Robert Carsen.

results.title: Mileva Einstein
results.overview: The film depicts Mileva’s life journey: from her childhood in Titel and her struggle for an education in a world where women lacked access to science, through her studies of theoretical physics in Zurich, to her complex emotional and intellectual partnership with Albert Einstein.

results.title: Ensemble Stars! The Stage -Blessing Moment-
results.original_title: 『あんさんぶるスターズ！THE STAGE』-Blessing Moment-
results.overview: Stage Adaptation of the Ensemble Stars! story, Human Comedy.

results.title: Fencing Teacher
results.overview: The great Mark Rakita is rightfully considered the father of the Russian sabre. One of Russia's most decorated fencers, he won his first Olympic gold back in Tokyo in 1964, and the second in Mexico City in 1968. In addition, he is a six-time world champion, a five-time European champion and a three-time USSR champion. Mark Rakita is also a great fencing coach and teacher, and it's not for nothing that he was awarded the title of Honored Coach of the USSR: he trained Olympic champions Viktor Krovopuskov and Mikhail Burtsev, as well as three—time world champion Sergei Koryazhkin. Rakita was feared because he was considered the smartest saber player on the globe and won not at the expense of strength, but at the expense of intelligence. Today Mark Rakita is 87, but he is still in the ranks – he is chairman of the Council of Elders and chairman of the Coaching Council of the Russian Fencing Federation.

results.title: The Space Circus attraction hunter (trash version)
results.original_title: O caçador de atrações do Circo Espacial (versão trash)
results.overview: In outer space, the famous Space Circus travels across planets performing the most fabulous acts. One day, tired of being oppressed and enslaved by the circus owner, two of its main attractions escape and end up on Earth. The circus owner then sends the Attraction Hunter to recapture the fugitives, but this turns into a life-or-death battle.

results.title: Holy Padel
results.overview: Max and Pablito love padel to the point of neglecting their families. Their wives, Helena and Soledad, try to stop them, but they also fall into obsession. The hobby becomes a battle of the sexes for control of the game and the home.

results.title: Simon Talbot: Ekstra Extra
results.overview: Confetti cannons, anecdotes, and deeply personal moments. Simon Talbot delivers a critically acclaimed show about life’s big and small struggles, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud while also giving you plenty to think about.

results.title: My Family
results.overview: A seemingly ordinary journey abroad, a seemingly harmonious big family, a young couple with their own worries, face the escalating danger of a runaway car. Survival and death, trust and suspicion, honesty and concealment, test the conflicting family.

results.title: You Got Gold: A Celebration of John Prine
results.original_title: You Got Gold: A Celebration of John Prine
results.overview: This concert film was shot in October, 2022, over two nights at the Ryman Auditorium in Nashville, TN. More than 70 artists gathered with family, the Nashville community, and music fans to remember and pay tribute to the life and songs of John Prine.

results.title: Feri Resham Filili
results.overview: When Resham wins the US DV lottery, village tensions rise. Stranded before reaching America, he reunites with unreliable friend Hariya. Both chase dreams amid lies, jealousy and survival challenges.

results.title: Pickleheads
results.overview: A former ping pong player tries to make a comeback through the sport of pickleball after a shameful televised loss, hoping to save his family home while confronting his past trauma and a rival player.

results.title: Lali: Time To Step Up
results.original_title: Lali: La que le gana al tiempo
results.overview: This documentary follows Lali in her return after four years away from the stage, showcasing the personal journey that led her to become the artist we know today.

results.title: Hagen Benz - Das Böse in dir
results.original_title: Hagen Benz - Das Böse in dir

results.title: The Treasures of the Gnomes
results.overview: A young swindler Roma deceives a wealthy old man out of his inheritance. Along with the property, he inherits four gnomes – good magical creatures capable of finding ancient treasures. But their power can only be used for good deeds. Roma, through deceit, begins to exploit them to get rich, but with each bad act, the power of the mysterious creatures wanes.
